content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The infrastructure for selling design assets using crypto payments is a game changer for digital creators. It eliminates reliance on conventional payment processors, which often impose high fees and geographical restrictions. By deploying a sovereign commerce stack, creators can retain more of their earnings, streamline payments, and gain complete ownership of their sales data. This matters because it empowers creators to operate independently, avoiding the pitfalls of platform dependence and enabling them to serve a global audience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture leverages free hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for deployment. It utilizes Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend processing, ensuring efficient order management and automation. NOWPayments facilitates crypto transactions, allowing for instant payment confirmations and minimal fees. For example, while Gumroad takes a hefty 10% from each sale, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, creating significant savings for creators. This streamlined setup allows digital products to be delivered automatically upon payment confirmation, optimizing the user experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where mainstream payment gateways fail to operate effectively. Whether you're selling ebooks, design templates, or courses, this solution caters to your needs by providing a reliable method for accepting crypto payments. It removes barriers created by traditional financial systems, enabling creators to focus on their craft rather than financial logistics. This approach is particularly beneficial for those in Nigeria, Ghana, and other countries facing payment isolation.
Eliminate platform fees and retain more of your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack comprises several key components: a hosting platform (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), a backend processor (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), a database for order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets), and a file delivery system (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2). Additionally, NOWPayments handles the crypto payment verification, ensuring the transaction is processed securely and efficiently. These components work seamlessly together to create a robust ecosystem that supports the sale of digital products without traditional payment platform restrictions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select the hosting service that suits your needs, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up the backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order management. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. Use a database like Supabase to track orders and delivery. Finally, host your digital products on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless access. By following these steps, you'll have a fully operational online store ready for crypto payments.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Gain complete control over your digital commerce operations.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to build a complete digital commerce solution, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all necessary blueprints and templates. This kit provides everything you need to deploy and scale a sovereign stack for selling digital products. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments in cryptocurrencies?

You can accept payments in cryptocurrencies by integrating NOWPayments into your sovereign commerce stack. This service allows you to process over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring that you can transact effortlessly.
What are the benefits of using a sovereign commerce stack?

The benefits include complete ownership of your sales data, lower transaction fees compared to platforms like Gumroad, and the ability to operate independently without reliance on traditional payment processors.
How quickly can I deploy my online store?
With the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can have your online store deployed within 48 hours, allowing you to start selling your digital assets almost immediately.
What types of digital products can I sell?
You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, design templates, courses, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software without any platform restrictions.
How do I ensure my products are delivered automatically?
By using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend processing, you can set up automatic delivery of your digital products immediately after payment confirmation through NOWPayments.
